import numpy as np
import eigen_ext

def ref(A):
    w, v = np.linalg.eig(A)
    idx = int(np.argmax(np.abs(w)))
    return w[idx], v[:, idx]

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
fails = 0
for trial in range(300):
    n = int(rng.integers(2, 11))
    A = rng.normal(size=(n, n))
    lam, v = eigen_ext.dominant_eig(A)
    # eigen equation
    res = np.linalg.norm(A @ v - lam * v) / np.linalg.norm(v)
    # compare with reference
    lam_r, v_r = ref(A)
    # eigenvalue should match (up to conjugate choice)
    lam_ok = abs(lam - lam_r) < 1e-8 or abs(lam - np.conj(lam_r)) < 1e-8
    # eigenvector should be parallel to reference (up to phase)
    cos = abs(np.vdot(v, v_r)) / (np.linalg.norm(v) * np.linalg.norm(v_r))
    vec_ok = cos > 1 - 1e-8
    if res > 1e-10 or not lam_ok or not vec_ok:
        fails += 1
        print(f"FAIL n={n} trial={trial}: res={res:.2e} lam={lam} lam_r={lam_r} cos={cos:.2e}")
        if fails > 5: break
print("done, fails =", fails)
